name: Sakai AI data center (former Sharp plant)
status_note: SoftBank is converting part of Sharp's former Sakai LCD plant (bought Mar 2025, ~¥100bn) into an AI data center: ~150 MW initially, ~250 MW by FY2028, potentially over 400 MW; completion now set for FY2027.

sources.title: SoftBank Corp. to construct large-scale AI data center that utilizes Sharp Sakai Plant
SoftBank buys former Sharp factory for $676m to build AI data center in Osaka, Japan

review_notes: Conversion works not yet confirmed by a source, so status stays 'announced'. Range: 150 MW initial vs 'over 400 MW' potential (SoftBank). Refine coordinates.
